svg.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Chalkboard SE, sans-serif

text.tspan: Three layout directions for a personal-finance UI (Finary / CoinGecko style). Goal: pick one (or a mix) before any UI code.
Yellow notes = D3SCOPE core components each layout needs. Numbers are fake sample data.
Core needs: area chart (time scale) + crosshair tooltip, donut + legend,
KPI number formatting (currency, %, sign colours), sparkline,
period selector -> chart.update(). Strength: everything at a glance.
Core needs: sparkline (many instances -> must be cheap), line/area chart,
-> plugin candidate). Strength: scales to many assets.
C - Focus tabs (one big chart, mobile-first)
Mobile: tabs become a bottom bar; insights move under the chart.
Core needs: treemap with drill-down, brush (time range) linked to the
main chart, transitions between tabs (d3-transition + motion),
responsive layout. Strength: simple, great on mobile, guided insights.
Risk: fewer numbers visible at once.
